title: Brussels Starts Enforcing, GPT-6 Prices Halve
summary: The EU AI Office has sent its first AI Act information requests to OpenAI and Anthropic over two agent incidents. Also: GPT-6 Sol and Luna pricing as a benchmark for your routing tables, and AWS's European Sovereign Cloud independence exercise this weekend.
